Racines d'Avenir est un institut de form: Racines d'Avenir is a vocational training institute.
Nous préparons les jeunes et les adultes: We prepare young people and adults for skilled trades through hands-on programmes lasting six months to a year, and we support them all the way to a job or a business of their own.
Nous transmettons des savoir-faire concr: We pass on practical know-how, in the workshop and in real-life situations, so that every learner becomes a competent and independent professional. Our programmes are built around employers' needs, so the skills acquired are immediately useful in the field.
Make a trade a choice for the future.
Nous voulons une formation professionnel: We want vocational training to be recognised and ambitious, valued by families and employers alike. The institute plans to gradually broaden its programmes and qualification levels, and to welcome learners from all over Africa in the future.
Chaque apprenant est suivi de l'orientat: Every learner is supported from orientation to employment: an orientation test on entry, a dedicated trainer throughout the programme, an internship supervised by a mentor, CV and interview preparation, then follow-up after graduation.
À la sortie, l'apprenant peut rejoindre: After graduating, learners can join a company from our partner network or start their own business: a tailoring workshop, a hair salon, a tiling or repair business. The institute and its Foundation help them take the step.
Elles guident nos choix pédagogiques, no: They guide our teaching choices, our relationship with learners and our partnerships.
Nous nous engageons pour la réussite de: We are committed to the success of every learner, with personal follow-up from orientation to their first job.
Des formateurs issus du métier, des atel: Trainers who come from the trade, equipped workshops and programmes designed with employers, for a qualification that carries real value.
Jeunes ou adultes, femmes ou hommes, ave: Young or older, women or men, with or without a diploma: everyone can find their path, including in technical trades.
Nous formons des professionnels capables: We train professionals who can work in a company as well as create and grow their own business.
Avec nos partenaires et notre Fondation,: With our partners and our Foundation, we support the most motivated learners: scholarships, equipment and mentoring.
Formateurs issus du métier, conseillers: Trainers from the trade, employment advisers, administrative staff: everyone supports learners day to day. Our trainers practise or have practised the trade they teach, and pass on its techniques, standards and realities.
Né à Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir s'appuie: Born in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir draws on the know-how and needs of Cameroonian businesses. Its ambition is pan-African: to train professionals able to work anywhere on the continent, and to welcome learners from across the region in the future.
17 formations professionnelles de 6 mois: 17 vocational programmes lasting 6 months to 1 year in Yaoundé: tiling, plumbing, electrical work, African tailoring, hairdressing, beauty, IT, accounting… Find yours.
